title: Getting Started with HTML
description: Introduction to HTML, its structure, and how it forms the foundation of web pages.

lessons.title: What is HTML?
lessons.content: HTML (HyperText Markup Language) is the standard language used to create and structure content on the web. It defines the meaning and structure of web content using elements and tags. HTML is the backbone of all web pages.

lessons.title: HTML Tags and Elements
lessons.content:
HTML is made up of elements enclosed in angle brackets called tags. Tags usually come in pairs like

and

. Elements can contain text, attributes, or other elements. Tags help browsers interpret how to display content.

lessons.title: Head and Body Sections
lessons.content: The `<head>` section contains meta-information, links to stylesheets, and the page title. The `<body>` section includes everything that will be visible on the web page—text, images, buttons, and more.

lessons.title: HTML Comments
lessons.content: Comments in HTML help document your code and are not displayed in the browser. They begin with `<!--` and end with `-->`. Comments are useful for explanations, reminders, or temporarily hiding code.

lessons.title: Void Elements in HTML
lessons.content:
Void elements are self-closing HTML tags that do not require a closing tag. Examples include `
